purpose: Repair the final performance runner only when it can be connected to an existing managed execution boundary without broadening runtime authority.
requiredOutcome: A final workload must be invocable through a concrete managed adapter, rather than an injected callback.
Fixture materialization must be a named, source-bound contract; it must not be inferred from generated routes or fabricated from generic request data.
Canonical evidence must come from the owned final run root and retain final-run provenance.
nonNegotiable: Do not call historical RM1 HTTP-diagnostic start/run/stop as a final-performance adapter.
Do not reuse r5-dev-runner because it is a DEV/seed boundary, uses a persistent R5 root, and has different ownership semantics.
Do not add network, SSH, process, database, object-storage, or fixture lifecycle management without an existing approved exported contract.
Do not run any dynamic command from this package.
knownAdmissionGap: No existing public managed adapter accepts a final plan/run root, owns only the final local application+tunnel+isolated remote namespace lifecycle, materializes the 396 source-bound fixtures, or supplies the final server evidence paths. The historical diagnostic runner is hard-coded to its RM1 kind/root/headers/workload set; the R5 runner is a DEV+seed boundary.
